decisions.value_zh: 面向个人与 AI 的本地优先、证据驱动、双向重型学习知识系统
decisions.value_en: Local-first, evidence-driven, bidirectional learning and knowledge system for individuals and AI

decisions.value: Rust/Tauri only for desktop host, OS boundary and process lifecycle
Static JS for A1; TypeScript/React as a separate later migration
SQLite remains the local core database
Apple-light default; Violet Core dark theme retained
Agent is an AI-usage application layer, not the product center
